band_rule: neutral: centre ± 1 SD; shape-linked: fade = centre + offset ± SD, draw = centre − offset ± SD; near = within 2 SD of the nearer band; far beyond

sources.SB: Sportsbox AI tour averages (help.sportsbox.ai; PGA and LPGA players, driver and mid-iron tables)
sources.SBR: Sportsbox AI tour ranges (the low-high spans of the same tables)
sources.KV: K-Vest PGA norms as printed in Grathwohl & Sillevis 2024
sources.SEV: Severin et al. 2022 (17 male amateur golfers, mean handicap 8.7, driver and 6-iron)
sources.VG: VectorGOLF metric glossary (tempo and thrust targets for Sportsbox AI trackers)
sources.MEI: Meister et al. 2011 (10 male professionals and 5 amateurs, 5-iron; shoulder line to the horizontal)
sources.GT: GOLFTEC public tour and high-handicap means (Golf Digest 2017; GOLFTEC lesson videos)
